title: Pure Bamboo Sword
summary: Bamboo Sword is an Equip Spell control and draw engine that revolves around Cursed Bamboo Sword's graveyard search effect and Golden Bamboo Sword's draw power. By locking the opponent out of their Draw Phase with Burning Bamboo Sword and skipping their Main Phase 1 with Terminal World, the deck establishes a complete turn-skip lock while attacking directly.

allow.Silent Swordsman LV3: Warrior monster that holds Bamboo Sword Equips and negates opponent's Spells that target it.
allow.Immortal Phoenix Gearfried: Boss monster that banishes an Equip Spell from the field or GY to Special Summon itself and provides monster effect negation.
allow.Infernoble Knight - Renaud: Special Summons itself while you control a FIRE Warrior and recovers a banished or GY Bamboo Sword Equip Spell.
allow.Fire Flint Lady: Special Summons itself while you control a Warrior to facilitate Link Summons.
allow.Foolish Burial Goods: Sends Cursed Bamboo Sword directly from the Deck to the GY to search any Bamboo Sword card.
allow.Terminal World: Continuous Spell that skips both players' Main Phase 2, creating a total Main Phase lock alongside Burning Bamboo Sword.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Infernoble Knight - Renaud or Fire Flint Lady to start plays.
allow.Cross-Sheep: Link-2 that extends plays when summoning extra deck monsters.
allow.S:P Little Knight: Link-2 removal and disruption boss that banishes cards on field or in GY.

main: Immortal Phoenix Gearfried
Banishes a Bamboo Sword from GY to Special Summon itself; equips opposing monsters and negates monster effects.
Infernoble Knight - Renaud
Extends as a Level 1 Warrior and recycles Cursed or Golden Bamboo Sword from the GY.
Fire Flint Lady
Free Warrior extender from hand to enable 2-Warrior Link Summons.
Silent Swordsman LV3
Level 3 Warrior target that holds Bamboo Sword Equips.
Cursed Bamboo Sword
Bounces another Bamboo Sword card to allow direct attacks and searches any Bamboo Sword card when sent to the GY.
Golden Bamboo Sword
Draws 2 cards while you control a Bamboo Sword Equip Spell.
Broken Bamboo Sword
0 ATK boost Equip Spell that serves as the primary name enabler for Golden and Cursed Bamboo Sword.
Original Bamboo Sword
Destroys all opponent's monsters when the equipped monster inflicts battle damage and equips a Bamboo Sword from the Deck.
Burning Bamboo Sword
Continuous Spell that skips the opponent's next Main Phase 1 when you activate a Bamboo Sword card.
Soul Devouring Bamboo Sword
Continuous Trap that skips the opponent's Draw Phase when the equipped monster inflicts battle damage.
Foolish Burial Goods
Dumps Cursed Bamboo Sword to immediately search Golden or Burning Bamboo Sword.
Terminal World
Prevents Main Phase 2 for both players, locking the opponent out of playing cards alongside Burning Bamboo Sword.
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches any Level 4 or lower Warrior starter.
extra: Generic Link-2 staple that banishes cards on field or GY.
Link-2 beast that draws, revives, or pumps monsters.
